take: Buffalo announced it has placed forward Justin Danforth on injured reserve. He is a fourth-liner who averaged about 9 minutes a game and had no points in six games, and the Sabres controlled just 38% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five-on-five. Over the three games he has missed, Peyton Krebs has moved onto his line with Beck Malenstyn and McLeod, and Tyson Kozak has climbed to 12:16 a night from 7:32. Buffalo (5-4-3) has held 52% of five-on-five expected goals overall.
